name: commitmg
description: A tiny VS Code extension that adds a single button to the Source Control 'Changes' toolbar to generate a commit message.
author: Abdulla Aldosari

commands.title: Generate Commit Message with Another Style...

commitmg.aiPathway.description: Whether CommitMG talks directly to a provider's HTTP API, or through VS Code's built-in Language Model API (GitHub Copilot Chat). This is set automatically when you choose a provider in CommitMG Settings.

commitmg.aiProviderName.description: The direct-API provider to use when commitmg.aiPathway is "direct". This is set automatically when you choose a provider in CommitMG Settings.

commitmg.aiModelId.description: The model ID to use for the selected direct-API provider. Leave empty to use the provider's default model. This is set automatically when you select a model in CommitMG Settings.

commitmg.aiCustomBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server to use when commitmg.aiProviderName is "custom". This is set automatically in CommitMG Settings.

commitmg.aiOllamaBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the local Ollama server to use when commitmg.aiProviderName is "ollama" (default: http://localhost:11434). This is set automatically in CommitMG Settings.

commitmg.aiVsCodeModelId.description: The vscode.lm model ID to use when commitmg.aiPathway is "vscode". Leave empty to use the first available model. This is set automatically when you select a model in CommitMG Settings.

commitmg.developer.enabled.description: Developer diagnostics: record every generation session (prompts, attempts, violations, and errors) under the extension global storage and log the created file paths to the 'Commit MG Developer' output channel.

enumDescriptions: Smallest prompt: no old-file context and a short diff. Fastest and cheapest.
Old-file context and a medium diff. A good default for most changes.
The most context: large old-file and diff budgets. Slowest, most detailed.
Use the individual context settings below.
commitmg.context.preset.description: How much of the change is sent to the model. Bigger prompts give the model more context but take longer and cost more.

commitmg.context.includeEvidence.markdownDescription: Send the committed version of each changed file as extra context. Used only when `#commitmg.context.preset#` is `custom`.

commitmg.context.evidenceBudget.markdownDescription: Character budget for the old-file context, across all files. Used only when `#commitmg.context.preset#` is `custom`.

commitmg.context.diffBudget.markdownDescription: Character cap for the diff sent to the model. Used only when `#commitmg.context.preset#` is `custom`.

commitmg.context.diffContextLines.markdownDescription: Unchanged lines shown around each change in the diff. Used only when `#commitmg.context.preset#` is `custom`.

commitmg.context.ignoreWhitespace.description: Leave whitespace-only changes (re-indentation, trailing spaces) out of the diff. When a change is whitespace-only, the full diff is sent anyway.

commitmg.context.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns of files whose changes are not sent to the model, such as lockfiles and generated code. Matching files are still named in the change summary. Patterns are relative to the repository root.

enumDescriptions: A detailed paragraph per commit type: the most accurate type choice.
One line per commit type: about 1,500 fewer tokens per request.
commitmg.prompt.typeGuide.markdownDescription: How the commit types are explained to the model. Used only when `#commitmg.context.preset#` is `custom`.

commitmg.context.untrackedMaxFiles.description: Maximum number of new (untracked) files whose content is sent when nothing is staged.

commitmg.context.untrackedMaxBytes.description: Maximum total size, in bytes, of new (untracked) file content sent when nothing is staged.

commitmg.generation.autoCorrect.description: When a generated message breaks a rule (header length, line wrap, scope), ask the model once to fix it. Turning this off saves a second request; you then fix the message by hand.

commitmg.generation.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the model to answer each request, in seconds. Reasoning models can need more time on large changes.

commitmg.model.reasoning.description: How much the model thinks before answering. Auto uses each model's own default. A level the chosen model does not offer is not sent.

commitmg.model.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Empty (null) uses CommitMG's default for the model. Models that do not accept a temperature never receive it.

commitmg.model.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may produce, reasoning included. Empty (null) uses CommitMG's default of 8192.

enumDescriptions: One blank line between body bullet points.
Body bullet points on consecutive lines.
commitmg.format.bulletSpacing.description: How the bullet points in a generated message body are separated.

commitmg.format.additionalInstructions.description: Extra instructions added to every prompt, such as "Mention the ticket number from the branch name". The project rules win when they conflict.

enumDescriptions: Emoji before the type: ✨ feat(auth): add login
Emoji before the subject: feat(auth): ✨ add login. commitlint accepts this one.
commitmg.format.emojiPosition.description: Adds the emoji of the commit type to the header. The emoji always follows from the type the model chose.

enumDescriptions: A plain summary with no type and no scope: Add login page
commitmg.format.convention.description: The header form of generated messages. Basic ignores the allowed types, the scope rules, and the type emoji.

enumDescriptions: Show the style picker on every press of the Source Control button.
commitmg.format.defaultDetail.description: The style the Source Control button generates with. Any other style stays one click away in the Source Control menu.

commitmg.rules.excludedScopes.description: Regular expressions matched against scope names. A listed scope that matches one is left out of the prompt and hidden from the Rules tab table. A scope that has files mapped to it is never left out.
